title: Airbnb occupancy rate
description: Three row types share one dataset: occupancy (one per listing and calendar month — availability, occupancy % and a sampled nightly rate), listing (one per listing, optional, never charged) and status (one per place, URL or listing id; never charged).

dataset.title: Occupancy by listing and month
dataset.description: One row per listing and month with days available, days blocked or booked, occupancy %, minimum stay and the month's sampled nightly rate; plus optional listing rows and one status row per job. Occupancy rows are billed as delivered; listing and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with jobs, listings, occupancy rows delivered and charged, months filtered by minOccupancyPct, rate samples taken, error counts and request stats.
